01地缘政治与海事安全 · 2026年11月13日

霍尔木兹海峡四艘油轮遭爆炸袭击

Four Tankers Struck by Explosions in Strait of Hormuz, Iran Says

Iran's military said four oil tankers were hit by explosions in the Strait of Hormuz, with two supertankers disabled after hitting mines on Wednesday and two more struck on Thursday afternoon in the eastern strait. The UK Maritime Trade Operations agency confirmed a merchant vessel was hit by an unidentified projectile about 14 nautical miles northwest of Ras Al-Khaimah, causing a fire in its engine room. Reuters said it could not independently verify the Iranian account; at least 10 ships were hit in the first ten days of November, after 37 attacks in October — the highest monthly tally since the conflict began.

伊朗军方称，四艘油轮在霍尔木兹海峡遭到爆炸袭击，其中两艘超级油轮周三触雷后失去动力，另两艘周四下午在海峡东部触雷。英国海上贸易行动办公室证实，一艘商船在拉海马西北约14海里处被不明抛射物击中，机舱起火。路透表示无法独立核实伊方说法；数据显示，11月前十天已有至少10艘船遇袭，10月袭击达37起，为冲突开始以来单月最高。

Singapore Strait Robbery Spike Sparks Fresh Security Warning

Three merchant ships were boarded and robbed in the Singapore Strait within nine days, leaving one seafarer injured and prompting a fresh security alert. The ReCAAP Information Sharing Centre issued an incident alert on 11 November covering the bulk carriers Star Calypso and APJ Priti 2 and the tanker Salsa. There have been 28 robbery incidents in the Malacca and Singapore straits so far this year.

9天内三艘商船在新加坡海峡东行航道遭登船抢劫，一名船员受伤，地区海事安全机构发出紧急警告。亚洲反海盗及武装抢劫船只区域合作协定组织（ReCAAP）信息共享中心于11月11日发布事件警报，涉及散货船Star Calypso、APJ Priti 2和油轮Salsa。今年以来，马六甲海峡与新加坡海峡已报告28起抢劫案。

Falklands Oil Dispute Heads for International Tribunal Ruling

The international legal dispute over development of the Sea Lion offshore oilfield near the Falkland Islands is heading for a ruling by an international tribunal. The decision will shape who holds the rights to develop hydrocarbons in the area and the prospects for the project. The long-running dispute touches on the sovereignty question over the islands and could influence the future of oil development in the South Atlantic.

围绕福克兰群岛附近Sea Lion海上油田开发的国际法律争端将进入仲裁裁决阶段，裁决结果将决定该海域油气开发权的归属与开发前景。这一长期争端涉及该群岛的主权争议，裁决可能影响南大西洋油气开发的走向。

加拿大恢复对伊朗油轮巨头 NITC 的制裁

Canada Puts Iranian Tanker Giant Back Under Sanctions

Canada has reinstated sanctions against the National Iranian Tanker Company (NITC), reversing relief granted in 2016 under the Iran nuclear deal. The package targets 11 Iranian entities, including the National Iranian Oil Company and major financial institutions, barring Canadians and persons in Canada from specified financial and property dealings with them. Foreign Minister Anita Anand announced the move at the G7 foreign ministers' meeting in Paris.

加拿大恢复对伊朗国家油轮公司（NITC）的制裁，撤销2016年伊核协议后给予的豁免。此次一揽子措施针对11个伊朗实体，包括伊朗国家石油公司和多家主要金融机构，禁止加拿大境内人士及海外加拿大人与之进行特定金融与财产交易。加拿大外长Anita Anand在巴黎七国集团外长会上宣布了这一决定。

05地缘政治与海事安全 · 2026年11月12日

马士基再遭网络攻击

Maersk Confirms Hit by Ransomware Cyber-Attack

Maersk has confirmed another cybersecurity breach after hackers gained access to an older IT system inherited through an acquisition and extracted data, nearly a decade after the NotPetya attack that cost the company up to $300m. The carrier said it has found no evidence of sensitive data being disclosed and expects no disruption to customer operations. Ransomware group WhiteArmor has claimed responsibility, saying it stole about 100GB of data linked to LF Logistics and demanding $5m in bitcoin — claims that remain unverified and which Maersk has not linked to the incident.

马士基确认再次遭遇网络攻击，黑客入侵了一套通过收购继承的旧IT系统并窃取数据，距造成高达3亿美元损失的2017年NotPetya攻击已近十年。公司表示，目前没有发现敏感数据外泄，客户运营未受影响。勒索软件组织WhiteArmor声称窃取了约100GB与LF Logistics相关的数据并索要500万美元比特币，但这一说法未经核实，马士基也未确认两者之间存在关联。

“港口拥堵已成新常态”：MSC 首席执行官警告

'Port Congestion Has Become a New Normal': Soren Toft

MSC chief executive Soren Toft has warned that port congestion is becoming a permanent feature of container shipping. Linerlytica estimates that more than 4.3m TEU of container capacity was tied up by congestion in August, above the 4m TEU record set during the pandemic. Kuehne+Nagel data for 4–10 November put average waiting times at 2.28 days in Shanghai, 2.25 days in Ningbo and 1.7 days in Singapore.

地中海航运（MSC）首席执行官Soren Toft警告，港口拥堵正成为集装箱航运的永久特征。Linerlytica测算，今年8月因拥堵滞留的集装箱运力超过430万TEU，高于疫情期间400万TEU的纪录。Kuehne+Nagel的数据显示，11月4日至10日，上海、宁波和新加坡的平均等泊时间分别为2.28天、2.25天和1.7天。

新加坡开放两个 LNG 浮式储存装置牌照申请

Singapore Invites Operators to Apply for Up to Two LNG FSU Licences

Singapore's Maritime and Port Authority (MPA) has opened applications for up to two LNG floating storage unit (FSU) licences, allowing the units to operate at Singapore anchorages to expand LNG bunkering storage and reload options and strengthen supply resilience. Applicants must own or charter an FSU of at least 130,000 cu m, be registered in Singapore and hold ISCC-EU certification to handle bio-LNG and e-LNG. Licences run for five years, with applications closing on 4 February 2027.

新加坡海事及港务管理局（MPA）于11月12日开放申请，允许最多两座LNG浮式储存装置（FSU）在新加坡锚地运营，以扩大LNG加注的储存与再装载选择、增强供应韧性。申请人须拥有或租赁至少13万立方米的FSU、在新加坡注册，并取得ISCC-EU认证以处理生物LNG与电制LNG。牌照有效期五年，申请截止2027年2月4日。

Jurong Port Taps Israeli Startup for AI-Powered Cargo Monitoring

Singapore's Jurong Port has signed a multi-million-shekel agreement with Israeli maritime technology startup Conbo to turn existing security cameras into a real-time cargo monitoring system using computer vision, generating digital twins and live data to improve visibility at its bulk and breakbulk terminals. 波罗的海干散货指数七连涨至 3,020 点，创一个多月新高

Baltic Dry Bulk Index Reaches Highest Level in Over a Month

The Baltic Exchange's main dry bulk index rose for a seventh straight session, gaining 61 points to 3,020 — its highest since 5 October. The capesize index climbed 136 points to 4,836, with average daily earnings up $1,232 at $40,357, while the panamax index rose to 2,117 and the supramax to 1,831. The sustained rally points to improving seaborne demand for iron ore, coal and other bulk commodities.

波罗的海干散货主指数七连涨，上涨61点至3,020点，创10月5日以来最高。海岬型指数上涨136点至4,836点，日均收益增加1,232美元至40,357美元；巴拿马型指数涨至2,117点，超灵便型指数涨至1,831点。干散货运价的持续回升反映了铁矿石与煤炭等大宗商品海运需求的改善。

12集装箱与干散货 · 2026年11月13日

煤炭贸易新秩序正在形成

Coal's New World Order Takes Shape

Shifting coal trade patterns are reshaping dry bulk shipping. Clarksons Research expects seaborne coal trade to grow just 1% this year to 1.343bn tonnes, with Indonesian exports down 6% to 496.9m tonnes and Australian exports up 4% to 371.3m tonnes. South Africa and Mozambique shipped a combined 64.92m tonnes of thermal coal in the first ten months of the year — a ten-year high — including 27.26m tonnes to India. The rerouting of trade flows is changing voyage patterns and tonne-mile demand for bulk carriers.

煤炭贸易版图的变化正在重塑干散货航运。Clarksons Research预测，今年海运煤炭贸易仅微增1%至13.43亿吨，其中印尼出口预计下降6%至4.969亿吨，澳大利亚出口增长4%至3.713亿吨。与此同时，南非与莫桑比克今年前十个月动力煤合计出口6,492万吨，创十年新高，其中2,726万吨运往印度；贸易流向的转移正在改变散货船的航线与吨海里需求。

德鲁里世界集装箱指数跌 2% 至 4,305 美元/FEU

World Container Index Falls 2% to $4,305 per 40ft

Drewry's World Container Index fell 2% this week to $4,305 per 40ft container as transpacific and Asia–Europe/Mediterranean rates declined on soft demand. Shanghai–New York dropped 3% to $9,020, its lowest since August, and Shanghai–Los Angeles fell 2% to $7,416, its lowest since September; Shanghai–Rotterdam declined 3% to $3,504, while Shanghai–Genoa was flat at $4,168. Drewry expects transpacific rates to fall further next week, with Asia–Europe rates edging up.

德鲁里世界集装箱指数（WCI）本周下跌2%至每40英尺箱4,305美元，因跨太平洋与亚欧/地中海航线运价下滑、需求疲软。上海至纽约跌3%至9,020美元，创8月以来最低；上海至洛杉矶跌2%至7,416美元，创9月以来最低；上海至鹿特丹跌3%至3,504美元，上海至热那亚持平于4,168美元。德鲁里预计跨太平洋运价下周继续下跌，亚欧航线略有回升。

Oil rose after President Donald Trump said the US "doesn't need a deal with Iran", dimming hopes of a diplomatic breakthrough. Volare Snaps Up $210m VLCC in Trafigura-Linked Deal

Trafigura-backed tanker owner Volare Shipping has agreed to acquire the VLCC newbuilding Veni Vidi Vici for $210m. The extension would require individual voyages to undergo case-by-case review rather than granting blanket exemptions. The current waiver expires on 15 November and is already the longest in the more than 100-year history of the Jones Act, though a White House official said no decision has yet been made.

四名业内消息人士透露，特朗普政府拟延长允许外国籍船舶在美国港口间运输石油等货物的《琼斯法》豁免，最早可能于周四宣布。新的豁免将要求每个航次单独审批，而不再给予一揽子豁免。现行豁免将于11月15日到期，已是这部百年法律历史上最长的一次豁免；白宫官员则表示尚未作出最终决定。

37政策与市场展望 · 2026年11月12日

NYK 描绘全球大宗商品贸易大洗牌

NYK Charts the Great Reshuffling of Global Commodity Trades

Japan's NYK Line has published its latest shipping market outlook, predicting a fundamental reshaping of global commodity trades. The VLCC fleet is forecast to grow from 909 vessels at the end of 2025 to 1,082 by the end of 2029, with about 290 supertankers due for delivery in 2026–2029. Seaborne iron ore volumes are expected to fall from 1.65bn tonnes in 2025 to 1.4bn tonnes by 2035, while LNG shipments rise from 433m to 622m tonnes, with India and Southeast Asia becoming more important demand centres.

日本邮船（NYK）发布最新航运市场展望，预测全球大宗商品贸易格局将发生根本性重组。VLCC船队预计从2025年底的909艘增至2029年底的1,082艘，2026至2029年间将交付约290艘超级油轮。海运铁矿石量预计从2025年的16.5亿吨降至2035年的14亿吨，而LNG海运量则从4.33亿吨增至6.22亿吨，印度和东南亚将成为更重要的需求中心。
